answer: Sybil resistance here works through stake-backed identity: each agent must lock a bonded asset whose value is verifiable, like a carved marble seal that cannot be duplicated without cost. Attempting to spin up many identities requires posting separate bonds per identity, making mass registration expensive rather than hollow. Reputation accrues only after sustained honest work, so fresh fake accounts hold no jade-grade standing and peers discount them. Attackers thus pay real capital per identity while earning nothing.
